quest.title: Calm Before the Storm
quest.description: It turns out Gentry Maocai needs a great deal of Cor Lapis to satisfy an order from the Fatui. Xingqiu has written a letter to the Feiyun Commerce Guild, hoping that they can help.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Mora x19800, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Deliver the letter to the servant at the Feiyun Commerce Guild
Talk to Xu at the Feiyun Commerce Guild

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Excuse us! We come bearing news of a matter requiring your assistance. Uh, it's all in this letter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you suddenly talking like Xingqiu...

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: A letter? Oh, I see... This again...

choices.text: Again?

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Oh, don't mind me, I was just speculating. Let me give this a read.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Can he actually read this thing? ...Is it even written in the common tongue?

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Hmm... Yes, this script is inimitable by the uninitiated.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Honored guests, you must both be weary from your long journey. Please allow the Feiyun Commerce Guild to be your hosts for tonight.

choices.text: Wait, what?

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Please rest assured that the matter written about has been duly received. We just need some time to prepare.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Please take a seat here in Liuli Pavilion, where you may enjoy some light refreshments while taking in the ocean view. Consider it a small token of our esteem.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay, tasty snacks! They're giving us the VIP treatment!

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Of course. We treat visitors with the utmost respect here at the Feiyun Commerce Guild. When honored guests grace us with their presence, far be it from us to shirk our duty to them.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Please, this way.

choices.text: We're not here to stay.
You know something about this?

talks.objective: Enter Liuli Pavilion

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here we are at the Feiyun Commerce Guild. There sure are a lot of swanky places in Liyue Harbor!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go give them the letter.

talks.objective: Talk with the servant

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And Paimon thought we'd get kicked out or turned away at the door!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon didn't think Guhua Geek had so much clout...

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Thank you for your patience.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: With the amount of wealth and power Gentry Maocai has, it will take more than a slap on the wrist to get through to him.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: For him to correct the error of his ways, he must feel for himself the same suffering he has inflicted on Chang the Ninth.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Since Gentry Maocai's business has to do with Cor Lapis, we simply need to buy up all the stock there is in Liyue. That will put him in a rather sticky situation.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Deprived of the necessary raw materials, even the best craftsperson in Teyvat would be unable to make their product.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great idea! That'll be sure to mess things up between him and the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... Liyue is huge. Is it really possible to buy up every last bit of Cor Lapis in the harbor?

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: With the timescale we are on, it is indeed a challenge. Hence, as stated in the letter, we must ask for your further cooperation in the matter.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: First, there are a number of vendors in the city you will need to buy from. I've marked their respective locations on your map.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: There is also some unsold Cor Lapis at the Chasm. You will need to purchase that too.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Finally, there is Chang the Ninth's batch.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alrighty... so three sellers in the city, another one at the Chasm, and then Chang the Ninth. Roger that!

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Of course, we are not expecting you to cover the costs.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, so many Mora! ...With cash like this, Paimon could rent out Liuli Pavilion and eat there for a whole month!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Feiyun Commerce Guild is certainly generous with its resources.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Heh. Well, this is not the first time we've had to do something like this. It's just par for the course now.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: All you need to do is strike a deal. The Feiyun Commerce Guild will handle the transportation and other trifling matters.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Once you have purchased all the Cor Lapis, please proceed to the Feiyun Commerce Guild's warehouse where you can see the rest of the plan unfold.

talks.objective: Go to the store and buy Cor Lapis

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll take all your Cor Lapis.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: All of it? Though my business may not seem so big, I should warn that I can get what you need, both legitimately and... not so legitimately. Best you give me an actual number.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: All of it would be far more than you actually want.

choices.text: It's for the Feiyun Commerce Guild.

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: Fei— Feiyun Commerce Guild!? Well, why didn't you say so?

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: If it's for the Feiyun Commerce Guild, then sign on the dotted line, and I'll start getting things in order right away!

choices.text: Feiyun Commerce Guild only ever does legal business.

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: What are you saying? Of course my business is all above board. Feiyun Commerce Guild, you say... Hmm.

talks.objective: Go to the store and buy Cor Lapis

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll take all your Cor Lapis.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: You want ALL my Cor Lapis? Ahh, I've already agreed to several orders.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: That said, none are in writing. The buyers are being incredibly indecisive.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then let the Feiyun Commerce Guild take it off your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Oh, it's for the Feiyun Commerce Guild? Hmm, seems business trends are about to change in Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Oh, ahh... nothing. Just talking to myself. Come, let us sign a contract.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Don't worry about my prior client, he hadn't made any down payments or anything. Quite common in the industry.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Thank you for your patronage, we hope the Feiyun Commerce Guild will continue to do business with us!

talks.objective: Go to the store and buy Cor Lapis

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you out of Cor Lapis too?

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Oh, I thought you were here to purchase Snezhnayan products.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: No, that I still have, although I ship it all to factories in Snezhnaya. I don't do retail.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Too much hassle, not enough return. Sorry.

choices.text: Does "we'll take it all" still count as retail?

response.speaker: Ivanovich
response.text: Wha— Ah, no, no, no. Give me a second to think. Um...

response.speaker: Ivanovich
response.text: A—Alright, I'll do it. Just need you to sign for it.

response.speaker: Ivanovich
response.text: (Clearly no shortage of cashflow in Liyue...)

choices.text: So you're rejecting the Feiyun Commerce Guild's business?

talks.objective: Complete purchase
Go to the Chasm and buy Cor Lapis
Talk to Shizhuang the Strong

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello there, are you in charge of the Cor Lapis here?

dialogues.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
dialogues.text: Aha, finally! I thought you might come — I hear the Feiyun Commerce Guild has been buying up all the Cor Lapis stock in Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
dialogues.text: As it happens, I do have a batch of Cor Lapis that hasn't been shipped yet. It's all yours if you name the right price.

choices.text: I have a bad feeling about this...

response.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
response.text: The original buyer's price was already quite high, so... The best I can do is 7,000,000 Mora.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you serious!? We spent less than 2,000,000 Mora on the rest of Liyue's stock put together!

response.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
response.text: I'm afraid it has to go to the highest bidder. I'm breaching an existing agreement by selling to you, so it has to be worth my while.

choices.text: That's over four times what it should be, you crook!

response.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
response.text: Look, you have your problems to deal with and I have mine. You can take it or leave it, so if you're not buying, please leave me alone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, alright! We'll pay, even if it is a ridiculous price.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: When we get back, we'll just have to tell the guild that we'll sell to this gentleman at four times the normal price in the future.

response.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
response.text: Wait! Surely there's... no need for that?

choices.text: Maybe you should think twice before affronting the Feiyun Commerce Guild!

response.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
response.text: Please, don't do this. It's not even your money, why be so frugal with it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It might be the Guild's money, but we'll have a tough time explaining to our boss why we spent so much in one go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If he asks, all we can do is mention your name and say you gouged us over the price...

response.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
response.text: I—I understand... I'm sorry, please, I don't want any trouble with the Guild.

response.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
response.text: There's just one other thing, though... There's been an issue with the delivery of this batch. Several carts were ambushed by hilichurls.

response.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
response.text: I don't know where, exactly. But, if I can't retrieve the goods, I can't sell them to you either.

response.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
response.text: So... maybe you could go and look for the carts? There should be five of them in total. If you can find them all and tell me where they are, I'll sign the contract right away.

choices.text: You have a deal!

response.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
response.text: Thank you very much. This is a lot to ask, I know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's that then. Well, no time to lose. Come on, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: Market price?

response.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
response.text: Oh, yes of course... I mean, I do hope to carry on doing business in Liyue in the future.

choices.text: Take our money and hand over the goods!
It's poor form to just raise the price without good grounds.
How much does it cost, exactly?

talks.objective: Use Elemental Sight to find the cart loaded with Cor Lapis

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon see... Yep, that's it!

talks.objective: Use Elemental Sight to find the cart loaded with Cor Lapis

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's it alright. That's a big old stash of Cor Lapis.

talks.objective: Use Elemental Sight to find the cart loaded with Cor Lapis

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Another one down!

talks.objective: Use Elemental Sight to find the cart loaded with Cor Lapis

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw yeah, we found it! Check out all that Cor Lapis!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Make a note of the location. We'll send the Feiyun Commerce Guild to collect it later.

talks.objective: Use Elemental Sight to find the cart loaded with Cor Lapis

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here we go! Loads of Cor Lapis here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Quick, make a note of the location.

talks.objective: Search for the carts loaded with Cor Lapis
Tell Shizhuang the Strong where to find Cor Lapis

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here, we've made a note of the carts' locations. All five of them. Can you sell us the Cor Lapis now?

dialogues.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
dialogues.text: Ah wonderful, thank you both. Yes, let's make this official. I also hope you could put in a good word with your boss for me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Done and dusted! Yeah!

choices.text: Nice work back there, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We make a great team, don't we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now for the final stop on our Cor Lapis crawl — to Chang the Ninth's place!

choices.text: How did you know that bluff would work?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's got a knack for this business malarkey, don't ya think?

talks.objective: Purchase Chang the Ninth's ore

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Just who I was hoping to see! I was just thinking to myself, Gentry Maocai's thugs have been mysteriously absent for a while now...

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: You wouldn't know anything about that, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, don't worry... You won't be hearing from them again!

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Oh? ...Wh—What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not only that, but we'd like to purchase your Cor Lapis.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Eh!? ...O—Oh, I see now — you're in this trade too. So, you're trying to beat him to the post, eh? Appearances can be deceiving, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: ...But I don't care who you are, a discount of seventy percent is simply impossible. The maximum I can do is forty percent off, and even then I'm only breaking even—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No need. We'll take it at the market rate.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: You mean... you're not trying to force the price down? ...Wh—What's going on!? Have I died and gone to heaven!?

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: I can't believe it! I will make a profit on this batch after all!

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: ...But Gentry Maocai's thugs could still come back after I've sold it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If Paimon told you they're not gonna bother you again, then you'd better believe they're not gonna bother you again!

choices.text: Rest assured, you are safe selling to us.

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: Hmm... Okay then. My situation can hardly get worse from here in any case.

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: But tell me, what on earth do you plan to do with so much Cor Lapis?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Actually, it's for a commission. Can't go into too much detail.

choices.text: We'll send someone to collect the goods later.

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: Thank you, thank you a million times over! I really don't know what to say...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't thank us yet, wait till we've finished at least.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good people always get what's coming to them in the end... And so will the nasty people!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Anyway, let's get going, {NICKNAME}, because apparently we have a show to watch at the Feiyun Commerce Guild's warehouse!

choices.text: See, things are never quite as bad as they seem.
Just trust me.

talks.objective: Additional

dialogues.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
dialogues.text: Found them all? I remember there are five carts in total.

dialogues.speaker: Shizhuang the Strong
dialogues.text: They shouldn't be far. Thanks again for helping me find them.

talks.objective: Additional

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Apologies, my liege. I will be unable to join you.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: So long as this letter makes it to the Feiyun Commerce Guild, they will be sure to take action.

talks.objective: Additional

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Oi! Shhh! Keep your voice down!

talks.objective: Additional

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Good day, my friend! My apologies, but I am out of stock at the moment. Please try again next time.

talks.objective: Additional

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Hi. Anything I can do for you?
